question: What do you need it to do?

answers.label: Hold two things together (they stay still)
answers.example: a shelf bracket on a wall, a lid clipped onto a box, two printed parts bolted together
answers.explain: The parts stay still against each other once they are joined.

answers.label: 3D-printed parts, or screws, nuts and magnets into a print
answers.example: snapping a printed case shut, a brass insert melted into a print for a screw, magnets glued into a lid

answers.label: No, never (permanent)

answers.label: Yes

next.question: Where does it join the tube?

answers.label: A lid, door or cover that opens and closes

answers.label: Press, pull or flip a catch or lever

answers.label: A rail, extrusion or grid

answers.label: Yes

answers.label: Click into set positions

answers.label: Turns

answers.label: Turns

answers.label: Lock so only a person can open it (key, code, trigger)

answers.label: Hold a load where it stops (brake or self-locking drive)

answers.label: Slides

answers.label: Bends, or something else
